description: Compute deterministic counts by rating, collection day, locale and reported version. Always report coverage.truncated and completeForWindow; counts describe the bounded scanned sample, not all store reviews.

query.description: Literal text to match in review title or body.

since.description: UTC ISO start of collection-time window, within the last 30 days.

until.description: UTC ISO end of collection-time window.

version.description: Exact reported app version; not available for all reviews.

name: get_review_stats
title: Count collected reviews
